platform: KSPC 88.7 FM Album and EP Submission Route
manual_review_reason: KSPC explicitly welcomes all genres but accepts only albums and EPs, not singles or demos. Its official page authorizes digital files or a downloadable cloud-storage link through a Cloudflare-protected first-party email action and permits a CD or record alternative. Streaming-only YouTube/SoundCloud, Spotify/iTunes, pay-for-play and work substantially generated through AI are excluded. A human must open the official page, use the protected destination without decoding it, verify international eligibility plus formats, file limits, metadata and explicit-content requirements, document non-AI provenance, and submit only one eligible album or EP through one delivery method.
